chosen.title: person walking on crosswalk
chosen.why: Low-angle close-up of sneakers walking toward camera on urban pavement (zebra crossing), natural daylight, no face, no text/logo. At 2.2s the lead foot heel-strikes the ground (toe up), so 'walking' reads instantly; the trailing foot swings through and plants again by ~3.3s, covering the 0.7s cut cleanly. Slight deduction because it is a crosswalk rather than a plain sidewalk.

alternates.why: Tight top-down close-up of shoes on grey concrete sidewalk walking toward camera, no face, neutral desaturated look. Only 720p available; foot plants at ~1.0s.
1080p, actual paved sidewalk, waist-down legs walking toward camera, no face. Framing is wider (legs rather than feet close-up) and the image is bright/high-key; foot plants at ~1.0s.

notes: Searched: walking feet, feet walking city, walking legs sidewalk (0 results), walking sidewalk, legs walking street. Also downloaded 23410 (man walking on concrete sidewalk, rear low angle, sidewalk, no face) as a 4th candidate but left it out of alternates: only 720p and heavily cool/blue graded. Chosen clip 98 duration 10.55s; in_point 2.2 + 0.7 + 0.1 = 3.0 <= 10.55. Alternate in_point ~4.9s in clip 98 is another heel strike if a later section is preferred.
